snippet.title: GTA 6 is FINALLY out: 6M live viewers & the "GTA flu" 🤯 #gta6 #shorts
snippet.description:
13 years of waiting… and GTA 6 finally launched on November 19, 2026. Over 3 million people watching at once on Twitch, 6+ million live across all platforms, trailers past half a billion views on YouTube… and thousands of people taking the day off to play. Did YOU take the day off? 👇

Follow Mile Zero for daily GTA 6 Shorts.

Launch-day figures are preliminary. Sources: Streams Charts / SullyGnome (live viewership), Guinness World Records (trailer 1), BambooHR survey of US salaried workers (stated plans), Logitech and Conor McGregor announcements as reported by the press.
